issues.issue: Did the officer apply the wrong test in assessing the best interests of the children?
issues.applicant_position: Officer gave generic best-interests finding, used a basic-needs approach and an implicit hardship threshold.
issues.result_quote: I am not persuaded that the Officer applied the wrong legal test

issues.issue: Did the officer err in the analysis of the applicants' establishment in Canada?
issues.applicant_position: Officer discounted establishment against an unexplained expected standard and ignored supplementary evidence on jobs and work.
issues.respondent_position: Officer is presumed to have considered all evidence; the ignored submissions show precarious employment.
issues.result_quote: I am persuaded that the Applicants have demonstrated flaws in the Officer’s analysis of the degree of establishment in Canada
